entry.content:
.NET MAUI 10.0.130

.NET MAUI 10.0.130 Release Notes

.NET MAUI 10.0.130 introduces significant improvements across all platforms with focus on quality, performance, and developer experience. This release includes 123 commits with various improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements.

Ai Agents

  • Add probability-scored duplicate issue detection by @kubaflo in #39218

Blazor

  • [inflight/current] Fix BlazorWebView root component subscriptions on disconnect (#39247) by @kubaflo in #39252

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] BlazorWebViewHandler never unsubscribes from RootComponents.CollectionChanged on disconnect, retaining the old MauiContext and finished Activity

  • Fix iOS BlazorWebView callbacks after disconnection by @sheiksyedm in #39430

    🔧 Fixes
    • BlazorWebViewHandler.iOS.cs NullReferenceException when web view has been disconnected

  • [WPF] Fix BlazorWebView disposal hanging when cleanup awaits JS interop by @sheiksyedm in #39497

    🔧 Fixes
    • [WPF] BlazorWebView.DisposeAsync never completes when a scoped service or component awaits JS interop on disposal

Border

  • ContentView and Border: hidden content shouldn't take up space by @FullDevStudio in #39560

Button

  • [Android] Fix ImageButton not rendering when CornerRadius is larger than half its size by @KirkPatrickJunsay in #39344

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] ImageButton does not render its background when CornerRadius is larger than half of its size (regression in .NET 10)

  • [iOS/Mac] Fix Button with gradient Background ignores CornerRadius by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #39484

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] Button with gradient Background ignores CornerRadius (regression in 10.0.80)

  • [Android]Fix for Android ImageButton Border Visibility and Update Test Snapshots for Issue by @BagavathiPerumal in #39526

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] ImageButton Border Not Rendering Correctly with URI and File Images when applying Aspect property

CollectionView

  • [Inflight/Current] [iOS]Fix for CollectionView layout issue after iOS device rotation by @BagavathiPerumal in #38771

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] I1_RTL_FlowDirection - Rotating the iOS simulator causes the item layout to change

  • [Windows] Fix doubled CollectionView item spacing by @jfversluis in #38960

    🔧 Fixes
    • CollectionView.ItemsLayout LinearItemsLayout ItemSpacing behaves significantly differently on Windows compared to Android (possibly Mac/iOS too)

  • [Android] Fix O(n²) layout cost in CollectionView GridItemsLayout (SpacingItemDecoration + ObservableGroupedSource) by @unrateddi in #38969

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView with GridItemsLayout: SpacingItemDecoration walks all positions for every cell — ItemsSource assignment and scrolling take seconds to minutes, ANR on fling (regression in 10.0.100)
    • [Android] CollectionView GridItemsLayout: span lookups over uncached positions are O(position) per cell, O(position²) when grouped — ScrollTo last group takes ~38 s for 10 000 items, scrolling up after a jump stutters

  • [inflight/current] [Mac] Fix VoiceOver announcement for actionable CollectionView items by @kubaflo in #39012

    🔧 Fixes
    • VoiceOver does not announce the role or interactivity of task items, making them appear as static text: A11y_.NET MAUI SDKs_VoiceOver

  • [Android] CollectionView GridItemsLayout: resolve span index and row from the items source instead of walking every position by @unrateddi in #39063

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView GridItemsLayout: span lookups over uncached positions are O(position) per cell, O(position²) when grouped — ScrollTo last group takes ~38 s for 10 000 items, scrolling up after a jump stutters

  • [Android] Keep CarouselView Position when CurrentItem isn't in the ItemsSource by @MykhailoDav in #39151

    🔧 Fixes
    • Android - Carousel View - always get an error "Can't set CarouselView to position -1. ItemsSource has 10 items."

  • [Android] Prevent unnecessary CollectionView item recreation on Header/Footer updates by @SuthiYuvaraj in #38808

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Changing CollectionView.Header recreates the adapter and every visible item view (regression in 10.0.101)

  • [Android] Keep EmptyViewAdapter view types from matching the items adapter's by @MykhailoDav in #39193

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] CollectionView with an EmptyView or EmptyViewTemplate gets potentially corrupted after being cleared and repopulated a number of times

  • [iOS] Fix vertical CarouselView Position synchronization by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #39377

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] Vertical CarouselView scrolls and snaps but fails to update Position or raise PositionChanged (Loop=False)

  • [Windows] Fix excessive blank space between CollectionView grid items by @Shalini-Ashokan in #39429

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] I6_Grouping_VerticalItemSpacing :Grouped CollectionView have extra space

  • [iOS/MacCatalyst] Fixed CollectionView: Preserve visible position when item spacing changes by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #37032

🔧 Fixes
  • I2-After changing the vertical spacing, need to scroll up to make the first item visible.

  • [iOS/Mac] Fix CollectionView2 height not updating when ItemsSource changes by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #38441

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Mac][iOS] CollectionView does not shrink its rendered height after ItemsSource is updated with fewer items

  • [Windows] Fix EmptyViewTemplate not displayed when ItemsSource is set to Null by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39513

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] EmptyViewTemplate not displayed when ItemsSource is set to Null

  • [Windows] Avoid CollectionView GroupHeaderStyleSelector accumulation by @sheiksyedm in #39525

  • [iOS] Collapse CollectionView group headers when their content is hidden by @carloshenriquecarniatto in #39533

  • [iOS] Fix Label truncation after item text updates in CollectionView by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39558

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] CollectionView Label renders truncated after Text updated with ItemSizingStrategy="MeasureFirstItem" (regression in 10.0.100, 10.0.110 & 10.0.120)

  • [Windows] Fix Compatibility CollectionView compilation on inflight/candidate by @sheiksyedm in #39662

  • [iOS, Catalyst] Fix IndicatorView not visible when applying RTL FlowDirection with IndicatorTemplate by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39501

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS, Catalyst] IndicatorView not visible when applying FlowDirection=RightToLeft with IndicatorTemplate

  • [inflight/Candidate]Fix CollectionViewItemSafeAreaEdgesShouldBePreservedWithShadow UI test failure by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39698

    🔧 Fixes
    • [inflight regression] CollectionViewItemSafeAreaEdgesShouldBePreservedWithShadow UI test failing in candidate PR 39597

  • [Inflight/Candidate][Revert] [iOS] Fix for CollectionView layout issue after iOS device rotation #38771 by @TamilarasanSF4853 in #39707

  • [iOS/Mac][Revert] CollectionView2 height-update fix (#38441) by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #39855

    🔧 Fixes
    • [NET 10] N_ScrollView - There are 2 vertical scrollbars on N1 and N4 for iOS

  • [iOS/MacCatalyst] Fix RTL CollectionView item positioning after rotation by @sheiksyedm in #39891

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI] I1_RTL_FlowDirection - Rotating the iOS simulator causes the item layout to change

Drawing

  • Fix TransformGroup memory leak with shared TransformCollection by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #38738

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] TransformGroup.Children — shared collection strongly retains transform group

  • Fix GeometryHelper flatteners generating NaN points when segment count truncates to 0 by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #38814

    🔧 Fixes
    • GeometryHelper.FlattenArc / FlattenCubicBezier / FlattenQuadraticBezier emit a NaN point when the segment count truncates to 0 (0/0) — a Path with a sub-pixel arc fail-fasts Windows with D2DERR_BAD_NUMBER (root cause of #8512, #13757)
    • PathIcon use Lucide svg path throw an exception

  • Fix PathFigure memory leak with shared PathSegmentCollection by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #38744

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] PathFigure.Segments — shared collection strongly retains path figure

  • [Android] Fix Shape clipping after display density changes by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #39249

    🔧 Fixes
    • MAUI Shapes render incorrectly after Android display density change

  • [iOS] Fix SafeAreaEdges on a CollectionView/CarouselView item template root is ignored when the root has a Shadow by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #39255

🔧 Fixes
  • [iOS] SafeAreaEdges on a CollectionView/CarouselView item template root is ignored when the root has a Shadow

  • Fix Rectangle Rendering as a Thin Line for Small Heights by @Dhivya-SF4094 in #37319

    🔧 Fixes
    • Rectangle renders as thin line instead of filled shape for small height values

Editor

  • [Android] Fix Material 3 Editor expanding to MaximumHeightRequest by @Shalini-Ashokan in #38587

    🔧 Fixes
    • [android] Editor auto expands wrongly to MaximumHeightRequest

Entry

  • [Android] Fix numeric Entry decimal-point input in comma-decimal cultures by @sheiksyedm in #39286

    🔧 Fixes
    • Entry Numeric Keyboard Does Not Properly Support Decimal Commas

Essentials

  • [iOS] Fix OrientationStateTrigger updates on iOS 27 by @sheiksyedm in #39709

    🔧 Fixes
    • OrientationStateTriggers are broken with iOS 27

  • [iOS] DeviceDisplay: Track scene geometry and display handoffs (.NET 10) by @jfversluis in #39879

    🔧 Fixes
    • DeviceDisplay.Current.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation always showing Portrait for iOS 27

Essentials Devicedisplay

  • Update iOS orientation handling to use UIDevice.CurrentDevice by @jgold6 in #39398

    🔧 Fixes
    • DeviceDisplay.Current.MainDisplayInfo.Orientation always showing Portrait for iOS 27

General

  • Fix ARGB value for MediumPurple color by @TomasGnG in #39077

    🔧 Fixes
    • [bug: Graphics] Colors.MediumPurple has incorrect ARGB value (#FF9370D8 instead of #FF9370DB)

Gestures

  • [Android] Don't throw when a PanUpdated handler removes the view as the pan starts by @MykhailoDav in #39153

    🔧 Fixes
    • Adding a GestureRecognizer with PanUpdated event and dragging the handle produces an error.

Grid

  • Fix Grid definition and nested-grid position invalidation by @mattleibow in #39409

Hybridwebview

  • [iOS]Fix for HybridWebView JavaScript Evaluation Exceptions and Incomplete Requests by @BagavathiPerumal in #39469

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] HybridWebView: failed EvaluateJavaScriptAsync crashes the app instead of faulting the Task

Image

  • [leak scan] Fix image-source service collection retention leak by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #38743

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] ImageSourceServiceCollectionExtensions.AddService — static mapping strongly retains transient collections

  • [Windows] Fix Image AspectFit when the bitmap is already decoded by @Empiree in #39343

    🔧 Fixes
    • Image.Aspect = Aspect.AspectFit breaks on Windows when using a WriteableBitmap as the ImageServiceResult for an ImageSource

  • [Graphics] PlatformImage: Read PNG dimensions from IHDR by @Nacl-HCl in #39378

    🔧 Fixes
    • PlatformImage.GetPngDimension reads PNG file signature instead of IHDR dimensions, returning incorrect image sizes

  • [Candidate-TestFailure][Windows] Render registered toolbar font icons through the image service by @sheiksyedm in #39750

Layout

  • [Android] Fix popup centering when content and margins exceed layout bounds by @sheiksyedm in #39561

    🔧 Fixes
    • Popups are no longer displayed in the center of the screen.

  • [inflight/current] [iOS] Use window scene display for layout decisions by @kubaflo in #39595

Listview

  • [iOS] Don't update a disconnected image handler when a cancelled load fails by @MykhailoDav in #39149

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] ListView with HasUnevenRows=true logs "PlatformView cannot be null here" when loading URI images

Localization

  • [inflight/current] Fix culture-dependent FontSize design-time validation by @noiseonwires in #39694

Mediapicker

  • [Android] Fix MediaPicker launcher disposal after garbage collection by @sheiksyedm in #39710

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] MediaPicker.PickPhotosAsync throws ObjectDisposedException ('ActivityResultLauncherInvoker') after a GC (regression in 10.0.110+)

Navigation

  • Throw a clear exception when a Shell route doesn't create a Page by @MykhailoDav in #39186

    🔧 Fixes
    • Navigation to ContentView results in NullReferenceException

  • [Android] Don't throw an IllegalArgumentException for every page popped from a NavigationPage by @MykhailoDav in #39183

    🔧 Fixes
    • Android navigation error when using NavigationPage
    • Error when navigating back and using a NavigationPage

  • [Android] Don't throw when a modal NavigationPage is dismissed while it's navigating by @MykhailoDav in #39181

    🔧 Fixes
    • System.InvalidOperationException: NavigationManager cannot be null here

  • [Android] Fix stretched Shell back button icon when IconOverride is not square by @KirkPatrickJunsay in #39366

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android][Shell] BackButtonBehavior IconOverride with FontImageSource renders stretched navigation icon

  • [iOS] Prevent NavigationRenderer pop continuation from accessing a disposed renderer by @sheiksyedm in #39458

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS 26] NavigationRenderer.RemoveViewControllers continuation throws ObjectDisposedException after the renderer is disposed

Performance

  • Fix [leak-scan] VisualStateGroupList.Clear — removed groups keep triggers attached by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #38439
🔧 Fixes
  • [leak-scan] VisualStateGroupList.Clear — removed groups keep triggers attached

  • [leak scan] Fix handler collection retention memory leak by @Shalini-Ashokan in #38768

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] MauiHandlersCollectionExtensions.AddHandler — static mapping strongly retains transient collections

  • [leak-scan] Fix VisualState trigger lifecycle when states are added or removed by @Vignesh-SF3580 in #38550

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] VisualStateGroup.States — removal skips nested trigger detachment

  • [Leak scan] Fix MauiHotReloadHelper.currentViews — disabled unregister leaves views rooted by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #38657

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] MauiHotReloadHelper.currentViews — disabled unregister leaves views rooted

Picker

  • Select a Picker SelectedItem that was set before its ItemsSource by @MykhailoDav in #39175

    🔧 Fixes
    • Picker does not select an item when SelectedItem precedes ItemsSource in XAML attributes order

Refreshview

  • [iOS, Mac] Fix RefreshView pull gesture when IsRefreshEnabled is false by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #39486

    🔧 Fixes
    • RefreshView - IsRefreshEnabled does not fully disable the refresh gesture on iOS

SafeArea

  • [Android] Fix incorrect top padding when translating views offscreen by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #37772

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] TranslationY out of screen creates broken layout padding

ScrollView

  • [Android] ScrollView: Apply runtime padding updates immediately by @Dhivya-SF4094 in #38985

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Setting the padding value through binding or by using x:Name does not update the ScrollView padding

  • [Android] Fix ScrollToAsync UI-thread livelock caused by the MapRequestScrollTo retry loop by @philipag in #39213

Shapes

  • Minimize CI workflow failures and pipeline start comments by @kubaflo in #39564

  • docs: fix Helix queues and device-test pipeline path in DevelopmentTips by @ZainnQureshii in #38850

  • Fix PathGeometry leak with shared PathFigureCollection by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #38946

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] PathGeometry.Figures — shared collection retains the geometry

Shell

  • Fix Leak Fixer validation shell permissions by @kubaflo in #39475

    🔧 Fixes
    • [aw] Memory Leak Fixer reported incomplete result

  • Fix CI-fixer empty-queue PowerShell module discovery by @kubaflo in #39522

    🔧 Fixes
    • [aw] CI Failure Fixer (main) reported incomplete result

  • [Material3] Fix tab selection indicator color on theme change by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #38445

    🔧 Fixes
    • Android Material 3: Shell TabBar Tab selection color does not update with AppTheme

  • Fix ShellItem.MenuItem memory leak caused by implicit wrapper by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #38804

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] ShellItem.MenuItem — implicit wrapper remains rooted by source item

  • [iOS] Ignore a pending Shell back navigation after the section renderer is disposed by @MykhailoDav in #39152

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] ObjectDisposedException

  • [Windows] Shell: Apply TabBarDisabledColor to disabled tabs by @Dhivya-SF4094 in #35885

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] TabBarDisabledColor is not applied when the TabBar is in a disabled state

  • [iOS] Fix iOS 26 blank page on rapid Shell tab re-selection by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #39360

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] Re-tapping the selected Shell tab during navigation leaves the tab blank

  • [Android] Fix SearchHandler toolbar icon tint when Shell.ForegroundColor is set on a TabBar, Tab, or ShellContent by @edgiardina in #39346

    🔧 Fixes
    • SearchHandler for Android does not respect Shell Foreground color for Spyglass icon

  • [Windows] Fix crash when clicking a tab with sub tabs in the Shell TabBar overflow menu by @Empiree in #39412

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] Crash (E_BOUNDS / invalid vector subscript) when selecting a Tab with nested ShellContent from the TabBar overflow menu

  • [Android] Fix Shell Renderer Content Layout in RTL Locked Mode by @Vignesh-SF3580 in #39462

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Shell Content Layout Issue in RTL Locked Mode

  • Fix Shell Flyout item ordering when CurrentItem is set in XAML by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #39541

    🔧 Fixes
    • Setting Shell.CurrentItem reorders items in flyout menu

Single Project

  • [iOS] Fix splash screen image not appearing by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #39426

    🔧 Fixes
    • Recipe Demo App launch screen logo doesn't show up.

SwipeView

  • Fix SwipeItemView Command Memory Leak by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #38316

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] SwipeItemView.Command — shared command retains the view

  • Fix SwipeMenuItems were rendered to the full width of the SwipeView instead of their measured width on Android, iOS, and macOS by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #38271

    🔧 Fixes
    • The SwipeMenuItems were rendered to the full width of the SwipeView instead of their measured width on Android, iOS, and macOS.

  • Wait for SwipeView command result before UI assertion by @kubaflo in #39092

  • [Testing] Refactoring Feature Matrix UITest Cases for SwipeView Control by @LogishaSelvarajSF4525 in #38193

  • [Android] Fix SwipeItem tap with fixed-width SwipeView content by @Shalini-Ashokan in #39314

    🔧 Fixes
    • [SwipeView] SwipeItem tap does not work with Image WidthRequest when configured in code-behind

  • [Android] Fix xUnit2031 warning in Android SwipeView device test by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #39375

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Controls.DeviceTests build fails with xUnit2031 analyzer error

TabbedPage

  • [Android] Fix TabbedPage: Selected tab icon loses SelectedTabColor after rebuilding Children by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #38801

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] TabbedPage: selected tab's icon loses SelectedTabColor after rebuilding Children a second time

  • [iOS 26] Fix TabbedPage tab bar layout by @SyedAbdulAzeemSF4852 in #38659

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS Glass UI bottom tabs show truncated labels

Toolbar

  • [Windows] Fix font toolbar icons when text is present by @jfversluis in #39685

    🔧 Fixes
    • ToolbarItem Icons Don't Show in Windows

WebView

  • [Windows] Fixed : WebView CanGoBack Returns true when it Shouldn't by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #37648

    🔧 Fixes
    • WebView.CanGoBack on Windows Returns true When it Shouldn't

  • [Windows] Fix WebView rendering alongside HybridWebView by @sheiksyedm in #39512

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] WebView Regression from NET9 to NET10
    • [Windows] the Webview control doesn't render and just show the window background

Xaml

  • [CI] Reduce build and Windows XAML warnings by @rmarinho in #38735

  • [Windows] Restore native binding metadata baseline to fix maui-pr by @kubaflo in #39622

  • Improve error message xaml sg by @pictos in #38712

    🔧 Fixes
    • Improve xmal error messages

  • [XSG] Make global xmlns generation deterministic by @noiseonwires in #38842

    🔧 Fixes
    • [XSG] Global.Xmlns.cs output changes with metadata reference order

  • Fix typed bindings invoking generated getters with missing ancestor sources by @jfversluis in #39470

    🔧 Fixes
    • SourceGen compiled RelativeSource AncestorType binding on Windows intermittently invokes its generated getter with a null source
🔧 Infrastructure (8)

  • [ci] Remove unused SDK insertion templates by @kubaflo in #39519

    🔧 Fixes
    • [ci] Migrate SDK insertion templates off the VSEngSS-MicroBuild2022-1ES pool

  • [ci] Retry pre-test setup up to five total attempts by @kubaflo in #39549

    🔧 Fixes
    • [RC2] Fix CI dependency and provisioning blockers

  • [CI-Improvement]Retry only failed individual UI tests across all platforms by @Ahamed-Ali in #39509

  • Bump the aspnetcore group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in #39683

  • Fix memory leak when replacing IndicatorView.IndicatorTemplate by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39353

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] IndicatorView.IndicatorTemplate — replacement leaves obsolete layout subscribed

  • Create CI fix PRs directly without scan issues by @kubaflo in #39711

  • Bump the windowsappsdk group with 1 update by @dependabot[bot] in #39745

  • Prepare SR13 for servicing packages by @kubaflo in #39774

📦 Other (16)

  • Add 10.0.120 to bug report version dropdowns by @kubaflo in #39494

  • Update PatchVersion from 120 to 130 by @kubaflo in #38778

  • Fix duplicate-detector MCP gateway startup by @kubaflo in #39589

  • Add /review expert-review GitHub workflow by @kubaflo in #39325

  • [Testing] Launch UI fixtures directly instead of navigating through the gallery by @kubaflo in #39621

    🔧 Fixes
    • [AGR] Fix android so it can launch directly to test

  • [Revert] [Testing] Launch UI fixtures directly instead of navigating through the gallery by @NafeelaNazhir in #39723

  • [iOS] Replace managed KVO observers with a Swift-owned observation to fix a crash in -[UIView dealloc] on iOS 17 by @albyrock87 in #38662

  • Address contextual PoliCheck findings by @dalexsoto in #39532

    🔧 Fixes
    • Address PoliCheck results

  • [inflight/current] Add iPhone Duo support to Controls.Foldable by @kubaflo in #39596

  • Avoid redundant boxing in coerceValue lambdas for value-type by @pictos in #39576

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Enhancement] Reduce allocations for value type in coerce value lambdas

  • [Android] SafeArea: let empty insets reach tracked views so SoftInput padding resets by @kevin68 in #39672

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] SoftInput padding stays after the keyboard closes when the window has no system bars

  • [Revert][inflight/Candidate][Testing] Launch UI fixtures directly instead of navigating through the gallery by @NafeelaNazhir in #39730

  • [Testing] Fixed Test case failure in PR 39597- Candidate - 1 by @NafeelaNazhir in #39664

  • Use GPT-6.1 Sol for test failure reviews by @PureWeen in #39738

  • October 23rd, Candidate — .NET 10 SR13 (10.0.130) by @kubaflo in #39597

  • Fix Windows debugging failure with .NET 10 SR13 by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #39830

    🔧 Fixes
    • [MAUI][.NET10] Debugging on windows fails using SR13

Full Changelog: 10.0.120...release/10.0.1xx-sr13
